pi.reason: Upgrade the bundled SDK to pi 1.7.0 (the CLI release the distro build downloads); checked against the 1.6.0→1.7.0 changelogs and a package diff. Breaking changes carried: showCacheMissNotices became the four notices.* keys (pi migrates the old key on load and drops it on its next save; lib/transcript-notices-server.ts and /api/cache-miss-notices read and write the new keys, legacy value as fallback), install telemetry and the enableInstallTelemetry setting / PI_TELEMETRY are gone (unused here), and a stored credential now reports configured only for a provider the model registry can resolve it for (only the provider-listing tests assumed otherwise). RPC protocol, extension API and file formats are otherwise additive: blockedKind on ctx.ui dialogs, fullOutputError on truncated bash output, --agent-dir, program resume.

pi-web.reason: Merged abcwyc v0.8.5 (967df692), which still ships pi-web 0.15.0 (upstream pi-web 0.16.0 is not merged there yet); LW adaptations are documented in docs/merge-history.md.
